source: Outlines, introductions and notes AI-drafted; holders computed from the atlas's own maps by tools/build_areas.py, so they are as approximate as the maps.

areas.name: Taiwan
areas.intro_zh: 南岛语族先民居住数千年，十七世纪起先后由荷兰、西班牙、明郑、清朝、日本和中华民国管治。
areas.intro: Home to Austronesian peoples for thousands of years; from the 1600s ruled in turn by the Dutch, the Spanish, the Zheng family, the Qing, Japan and the Republic of China.

notes.zh: 此前没有国家政权，岛上是各原住民族群。地图上的空白不等于无人居住。
notes.en: No state held the island before this; it was home to many indigenous peoples. Blank on the map does not mean empty.

notes.zh: 《马关条约》割让给日本，1945年日本投降后由中华民国接收。
notes.en: Ceded to Japan by the Treaty of Shimonoseki; taken over by the Republic of China after Japan's surrender in 1945.

notes.zh: 1949年起由中华民国政府管治。中华人民共和国主张台湾是其领土的一部分；两岸对主权各有主张，国际上对此立场不一。
notes.en: Governed by the Republic of China since 1949. The People's Republic of China claims Taiwan as part of its territory; the two sides hold different positions on sovereignty, and other countries' positions vary.

areas.name: Xinjiang
areas.intro_zh: 古称西域，绿洲城邦与草原游牧政权交替兴衰，汉、唐、元、清曾在此设官管辖，1884年建省。
areas.intro: The Western Regions of old: oasis city-states and steppe powers rose and fell here; the Han, Tang, Yuan and Qing governed it at times, and it became a province in 1884.

notes.zh: 喀什一带曾成立“东突厥斯坦伊斯兰共和国”，存在不足一年。
notes.en: An East Turkestan Islamic Republic existed around Kashgar for under a year.

notes.zh: 伊犁、塔城、阿山三区成立“东突厥斯坦共和国”，与国民政府对峙，1949年并入中华人民共和国。
notes.en: The Three Districts (Ili, Tarbagatai, Altai) formed a Second East Turkestan Republic, opposing the Nationalist government; it joined the People's Republic of China in 1949.

areas.name: Tibet
areas.intro_zh: 吐蕃王朝在七至九世纪统一高原，此后分裂；元朝起中原王朝以不同方式管辖或羁縻，各时期的关系性质学界有争论。
areas.intro: The Tibetan Empire united the plateau in the 600s–800s and then broke apart; from the Yuan onward, dynasties based in China ruled or oversaw it in different ways, and the nature of each period's relationship is debated by historians.

notes.zh: 明朝与西藏的关系是否构成主权管辖，学界有争论；本图明代未把西藏画入明朝。
notes.en: Whether the Ming held sovereignty over Tibet is debated; this atlas leaves Tibet outside the Ming on its maps.

notes.zh: 清亡后西藏地方政府实际自治，中华民国主张西藏为其领土。
notes.en: After the fall of the Qing the Tibetan government ruled itself in practice; the Republic of China claimed Tibet as its territory.

notes.zh: 1951年《十七条协议》后由中华人民共和国管辖。
notes.en: Governed by the People's Republic of China since the Seventeen Point Agreement of 1951.

areas.name: Northeast China (Manchuria)
areas.intro_zh: 肃慎、扶余、高句丽、渤海、辽、金等政权先后兴起于此，满洲人在这里建立后金，入关建立清朝。
areas.intro: Sushen, Buyeo, Goguryeo, Balhae, the Liao and the Jin rose here in turn; the Manchus founded the Later Jin here before taking China as the Qing.

notes.zh: 日本扶植“满洲国”，国际联盟不予承认。
notes.en: Japan set up the puppet state of Manchukuo, which the League of Nations refused to recognise.

areas.name: Outer Manchuria
areas.intro_zh: 黑龙江以北、乌苏里江以东，清朝依 1689年《尼布楚条约》领有，1858年《瑷珲条约》和 1860年《北京条约》割让给俄国。
areas.intro: North of the Amur and east of the Ussuri: held by the Qing under the Treaty of Nerchinsk (1689), then ceded to Russia by the treaties of Aigun (1858) and Peking (1860).

notes.zh: 中国史学界通常称这两个条约为不平等条约。
notes.en: Chinese historians generally count these among the unequal treaties.

areas.name: Outer Mongolia
areas.intro_zh: 匈奴、突厥、回鹘、蒙古等草原帝国的腹地，清朝时为喀尔喀蒙古，今为蒙古国。
areas.intro: The heartland of the Xiongnu, Turkic, Uyghur and Mongol empires; Khalkha Mongolia under the Qing; today the State of Mongolia.

notes.zh: 1911年宣布独立，中华民国直到 1946年才承认。
notes.en: Declared independence in 1911; the Republic of China recognised it only in 1946.

areas.name: Hexi Corridor
areas.intro_zh: 祁连山与沙漠之间的通道，丝绸之路的咽喉，月氏、匈奴、汉、五凉、吐蕃、归义军、西夏先后据有。
areas.intro: The passage between the Qilian Mountains and the desert, the throat of the Silk Road; held in turn by the Yuezhi, Xiongnu, Han, the Five Liang states, Tibet, the Guiyi Circuit and Western Xia.

areas.name: Yunnan
areas.intro_zh: 古滇国之地，唐时南诏、宋时大理独立建国，元朝灭大理后设云南行省。
areas.intro: The land of ancient Dian; independent as Nanzhao under the Tang and Dali under the Song, until the Yuan conquered Dali and made it a province.

areas.name: Hainan
areas.intro_zh: 黎族先民的家园，汉武帝时设珠崖、儋耳二郡，后来长期是贬官流放之地。
areas.intro: Home of the Li people's ancestors; Emperor Wu of Han set up commanderies here, and it was long a place of exile for officials.

areas.name: Northern Vietnam (Jiaozhi)
areas.intro_zh: 红河三角洲一带，秦汉至唐由中原王朝设郡县管辖约千年，939年吴权建国后独立。
areas.intro: The Red River delta; ruled as commanderies by dynasties from China for about a thousand years from the Qin and Han to the Tang, independent after Ngô Quyền founded his kingdom in 939.

areas.name: Sakhalin
areas.intro_zh: 阿伊努人、尼夫赫人等的家园，元明清曾羁縻其部落，1860年后归俄国，南半部 1905–1945年属日本。
areas.intro: Home of the Ainu, Nivkh and others; the Yuan, Ming and Qing held loose sway over its peoples; Russian after 1860, with the south Japanese from 1905 to 1945.

areas.name: Transoxiana
areas.intro_zh: 阿姆河与锡尔河之间，撒马尔罕、布哈拉所在，粟特商人的故乡，波斯、希腊、突厥、阿拉伯、蒙古、帖木儿先后统治。
areas.intro: Between the Oxus and the Jaxartes, the land of Samarkand and Bukhara and home of the Sogdian merchants; ruled in turn by Persians, Greeks, Turks, Arabs, Mongols and Timur.

areas.name: Kashmir
areas.intro_zh: 喜马拉雅西端的山谷与高原，印度教、佛教、伊斯兰教王朝先后统治，1846年起为英属印度下的土邦。
areas.intro: Valleys and plateaus at the western end of the Himalaya, ruled by Hindu, Buddhist and Muslim dynasties, and a princely state under British India from 1846.

notes.zh: 1947年起被印度、巴基斯坦分别控制，双方都主张全境；阿克赛钦由中国控制，印度主张。地图按实际控制绘制。
notes.en: Since 1947 divided between India and Pakistan, each claiming the whole; Aksai Chin is held by China and claimed by India. The map shows who controls what.

areas.name: Punjab
areas.intro_zh: 五河之地，哈拉帕文明的中心之一，此后波斯、马其顿、贵霜、德里苏丹、莫卧儿、锡克帝国和英国先后统治，1947年分属印巴。
areas.intro: The land of five rivers, a centre of the Harappan civilisation; later held by Persia, Macedon, the Kushans, Delhi, the Mughals, the Sikh Empire and Britain, and split between India and Pakistan in 1947.

areas.name: Bengal
areas.intro_zh: 恒河与布拉马普特拉河三角洲，波罗王朝、孟加拉苏丹国、莫卧儿和英国东印度公司先后统治，1947年东西分治。
areas.intro: The Ganges–Brahmaputra delta, ruled by the Pala, the Bengal Sultanate, the Mughals and the East India Company, and partitioned in 1947.

areas.name: Palestine (region)
areas.intro_zh: 地中海东岸南部，迦南、以色列、犹大诸国之地，此后亚述、巴比伦、波斯、希腊、罗马、阿拉伯、十字军、马穆鲁克、奥斯曼和英国先后统治。
areas.intro: The southern Levant, land of Canaan and the kingdoms of Israel and Judah; later ruled by Assyria, Babylon, Persia, the Greeks, Rome, the Arabs, the Crusaders, the Mamluks, the Ottomans and Britain.

notes.zh: 1948年以色列建国，此后约旦河西岸和加沙的归属一直有争议；联合国把 1967年后的西岸和加沙视为被占领的巴勒斯坦领土。地图按实际控制绘制。
notes.en: Israel was founded in 1948; the status of the West Bank and Gaza has been disputed since; the UN regards the West Bank and Gaza as occupied Palestinian territory since 1967. The map shows who controls what.

runs: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国

areas.name: Crimea
areas.intro_zh: 希腊殖民城邦、博斯普鲁斯王国、拜占庭、金帐汗国、克里米亚汗国先后据有，1783年并入俄国，1954年划归乌克兰。
areas.intro: Held in turn by Greek colonies, the Bosporan Kingdom, Byzantium, the Golden Horde and the Crimean Khanate; annexed by Russia in 1783 and transferred to Ukraine in 1954.

notes.zh: 2014年起由俄罗斯控制；乌克兰和联合国大会多数成员国不承认俄方吞并。
notes.en: Controlled by Russia since 2014; Ukraine and most UN General Assembly members do not recognise the annexation.

runs: 加利西亚-沃里尼亚公国

areas.name: Sicily
areas.intro_zh: 地中海的十字路口：希腊人、迦太基、罗马、拜占庭、阿拉伯、诺曼、西班牙、波旁先后统治，1860年并入意大利。
areas.intro: The crossroads of the Mediterranean: Greeks, Carthage, Rome, Byzantium, the Arabs, the Normans, Spain and the Bourbons ruled it before it joined Italy in 1860.

areas.name: Andalusia
areas.intro_zh: 伊比利亚半岛南部，罗马的贝提卡行省，711年起为伊斯兰的安达卢斯，1492年格拉纳达陷落后归卡斯蒂利亚。
areas.intro: Southern Iberia: Rome's province of Baetica, Muslim al-Andalus from 711, and Castilian after Granada fell in 1492.

areas.name: Bohemia
areas.intro_zh: 布拉格所在的盆地，波希米亚王国长期是神圣罗马帝国的一部分，后归哈布斯堡，1918年起为捷克斯洛伐克、今捷克。
areas.intro: The basin around Prague; the Kingdom of Bohemia was long part of the Holy Roman Empire and then the Habsburg lands, Czechoslovakia from 1918 and Czechia today.

areas.name: Alsace
areas.intro_zh: 莱茵河左岸，长期属神圣罗马帝国，十七世纪归法国，此后在法德之间四度易手。
areas.intro: The left bank of the Rhine, long part of the Holy Roman Empire, French from the 1600s and then passed between France and Germany four times.

notes.zh: 普法战争后割让给德意志帝国。
notes.en: Ceded to the German Empire after the Franco-Prussian War.

notes.zh: 二战中被纳粹德国吞并。
notes.en: Annexed by Nazi Germany during the Second World War.

areas.name: Tunisia (old Carthage)
areas.intro_zh: 迦太基的故地，罗马的阿非利加行省，此后汪达尔、拜占庭、阿拉伯、哈夫斯、奥斯曼和法国先后统治。
areas.intro: Carthage's homeland and Rome's province of Africa, later ruled by the Vandals, Byzantium, the Arabs, the Hafsids, the Ottomans and France.

areas.name: Texas
areas.intro_zh: 原住民科曼奇等族的土地，先后属西班牙、墨西哥，1836年独立为得克萨斯共和国，1845年并入美国。
areas.intro: Land of the Comanche and other peoples; Spanish, then Mexican, independent as the Republic of Texas in 1836 and part of the United States from 1845.

areas.name: California
areas.intro_zh: 原住民部落众多，十八世纪西班牙在此建传教站，后属墨西哥，1848年美墨战争后归美国。
areas.intro: Home to many native peoples; Spain built missions here in the 1700s; then Mexican, and American after the Mexican–American War in 1848.
